id_to_batch={ident:r['batch_id'] for r in s['batch_reviews'] for ident in r['asset_ids']}
pack={'schema':'approved-partial-sticker-kit/1','source_image':'approved-source.png','base_image':'base.png',

      'coordinate_status':'完整层级及精确放置待全套真实组装；近似锚点不冒称实测坐标',
      'generation_method':'built-in image_gen; original RGBA preserved','contains_unapproved_stickers':False}
refs={};prompts={}

    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(a['approved_file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['sha256']
    q={k:a[k] for k in ['id','name_zh','version','native_pixel_size_wh','mode','alpha_extrema','sha256','approved_by_user','packaged','alignment_status']}
    batch=root/'pending'/('batch-'+id_to_batch[a['id']][1:])

pm=root/f'package-manifest-001-{count:03d}.json';pm.write_text(json.dumps(pack,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
desc=root/f'已确认素材说明_001-{count:03d}.txt'
